page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; faint show-through from the reverse side in the lower half (not transcribed); catchword "CATA-" at lower right; signature at foot left and right.

main_text.p: Notum sit omnibus, quod Volricus dictus Bueler pro se & Gerdrude vxore sua designauit decimam luam in Honegg sitam in monte, qui dicitur Ruggebain officio Celleratii, qui soluere annuatim debet ix. floren. & ordinauit de prædictis bonis quando vnus ipsorum decesserit, tantum detur media pars: & decedente altero, pars integra ministretur. Et ad memoriam huius facti singulis annis tenentur dare vnum fertonem ceræ in festo B. Galli.
main_text.head: ELIZABET RELCAN.
main_text.p: Anno Domini MCCLXXXVII. Elizabet Relcan quondam de Riuti instituit annuatim i.s.pro remedio animæ suæ, & instituit i. s. pro remedio patris sui, in vigilia Galli de curia sua iuxta capellam B. Valentini, quæ dicitur Furtnua prope Riuti.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Pages largely illegible from show-through in the lower half; those lines are omitted. Roman numeral "MCCLXXXVII" is read from a faint printed "MccLxxxvii" and may be imprecise. The "1" in "197" style marks and the catchword are as read. The signature mark is uncertain.
